III. MONTHLY ACTIVITY

Clearup procedures were repeated for the LC analysis of ETV to check for reproducibility. Tobacco samples spiked with ETV were run by the NCSJ procedure and results were unsatisfactory. Triumph cigarettes supplied by T. Jessup were sent to Southern Research Labs., for analysis of ETOC. These same cigarettes are being analyzed for ETV in Analytical.

ETU treated cigarettes were analyzed for ETU delivery to mainstream smoke.
